notes.notes:

notes.title: Halloween patch
notes.notes:
In Halloween’s spirit the game is 40% off, plus we released a Scary Patch - it introduces new bugs! Mha-ha-ha!!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/voZ3pQE.png[/img]

[h1]HALLOWEEN PATCH[/h1]

Today we are releasing a tiny patch! It contains new voice lines, some new graphics and YOUR JOKES! From the contest!! That’s right - we finally did it! No need to thank us.
The patch is going to stay live ‘till Monday (November 5), then we gonna roll it back and prep the Christmas patch!

[h1]PATCH NOTES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added jokes from the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/574560/discussions/0/1694922526906459219/]Contest[/url] (with lucky fans’ names in the credits)
[*]Couple of spooky greetings
[*]New Halloween themed art in the menu
[*]Halloween cup... Wait, have we finished that? Ok, maybe no Halloween cup :)
[*]Sadly, no new puzzles. You can read more about it here: [url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/dude-stop/news/dude-stop-halloween-patch]indieDB blog.[/url]
[/list]

[h1]CONCLUSION[/h1]

Grab the game while it’s on sale, adore flying ghosts in the menu, [strike]collect rare Halloween Cup[/strike], laugh from new voice lines, and... I’ll go and chew on a pumpkin. CYA!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27371218/dcccb0f3979623f964b096ffb3302576e1a4cbe6.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hello!!

Thank you everyone for playing the game, and reporting problems to us! We fixed new bunch, and releasing our next [b]MAJOR[/b] patch! Let's see what's in the menu:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27371218/dcccb0f3979623f964b096ffb3302576e1a4cbe6.png[/img]

[h1]PATCH NOTES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Getting Completionist achievement should be easier - you don't need cups, that aren't visible.
[*]Cheaters achievement won't randomly trigger. You need to use special tactics!!
[*]Sounds on the car puzzle won't leak on the next puzzle
[*]Ending on the Pack10 won't show 2 screens at the same time
[*]Subtitles on/off now properly save its state upon exit
[*]You won't find new JigSaw pieces after collecting all 20
[*]And few other minor fixes.
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27371218/dcccb0f3979623f964b096ffb3302576e1a4cbe6.png[/img]

That's all we had time to fix today... But wait!! There is more:

[list]
[*][b]Localization news[/b] are coming
[*][b]Linux build[/b] is being tested
[*]And... hm. How are you? :D
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hello!!

The release was so much fun, and not stressful at all, HAHA!
And now, a day later, few of you reported some problems that we already fixed! But let's do a proper patch notes, like adults do:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27371218/dcccb0f3979623f964b096ffb3302576e1a4cbe6.png[/img]

[h1]PATCH NOTES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed some minor gramatical errors
[*]Fixed kind of a big thing with the voice - it was causing a variety of problems, like "no ending found" or ... others.
[*]Save files are less likely to be corrupt on the ALT+F4 or unexpected exit. Now it uses futuristic system of doing backups and stuff.
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27371218/dcccb0f3979623f964b096ffb3302576e1a4cbe6.png[/img]

If you encounter anything else - please let us know! Oh, and... Don't forget to [b]leave a Review[/b]!! He-he! Am... Thanks! :D

notes.title: Release Trailer is out!
notes.notes:
The game is coming out in just 2 days, so get a look at the [b]Release Trailer[/b] featuring all the features!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/EqakbW3.gif[/img]

[h1]RELEASE TRAILER[/h1]

Before you see the trailer, let us tell you a story about how we got the idea for the game, or how many times we thought about ... Nah, I’m kidding! Let’s just dive in!!

[url=https://patomkin.com/s/release-trailer]→ Trailer ← [/url]

[h1]PRICE[/h1]

[i]The price for the Dude, Stop will be 12.99€ or 14.99$ with a 10% launch discount for the first week.[/i]

And before you take out your pitchforks, just remember that we have [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/574560/discussions/]2 contests[/url] running, where you can get a [b]FREE COPY[/b] of the game!

But in all seriousness, we tried to make the price as low as we could allow it. And before you say “but your game has pixels instead of real art”, just remember that the game is about Voice interactions, and making that Voice angry. Where else can you find something like that?! Exactly!

Read the full statement here: [url=https://patomkin.com/s/release-trailer]Latest blog post[/url]

[h1]CONCLUSION[/h1]

Tradings cards are finished, achievements are implemented, the game is play-tested daily, Steam approved our game, and even the Release Trailer is out!!... What’s the next logical step?! That’s right - release the game in 2 days, on [u]June 1st[/u]! We hope to see you all there! And bring friends, yeah!!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27371218/dcccb0f3979623f964b096ffb3302576e1a4cbe6.png[/img]

99% can’t even click these links. Can you?! Are you special?! notes.title: Release Date Announcement Teaser
notes.notes:
Guess what we are about to announce... ;)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/f6tM31K.gif[/img]

[h1]RELEASE TEASER[/h1]

Well, if you want to know the date, you’ll have to work for it!!... Click this link, and watch the YouTube video there. Then come back and tell us how excited you are!

[url=http://patomkin.com/s/release-date]--> Release Date Announcement Teaser <--[/url]

Oh, and don’t forget to read the stuff below the video as well. We were writing it for you, you know. Because we care... Ugh! Fine! Let’s briefly talk about it again, to be sure you know everything you need:

[h1]RELEASE DATE[/h1]

“Dude, Stop” is officially coming out on [u]June 1st, 2018[/u]! The main platform is going to be PC, the price is still being decided on, and yes the game is going to have Steam Achievements, Cards, Badges and the rest!

[h1]CONTEST[/h1]

We have an idea to run a contest! The prize could be your name in the credits, or a free copy of the game! Yeah! FREE!... Right now we are in the stages of preparing the art and rules, so please come back when contest is officially on. We will announce it here, on our [url=https://discord.gg/SdWBfVS]Discord Server[/url] and on every other soc. media you are following us! (links below)

[h1]CONCLUSION[/h1]

The Release Date is in 2 weeks, the Release Trailer is in the works, some Contests are coming your way, more blog posts and one Surprise Video! We, on our side, are both scared and excited, so please be gentle with us! We still have lots of work and testing to do while getting ready for the release!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27371218/dcccb0f3979623f964b096ffb3302576e1a4cbe6.png[/img]

When you’ll miss a contest we had, please blame yourself for not clicking these links earlier: [url=https://discord.gg/SdWBfVS]Discord Server[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/dudestopgame/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/ArtjomsNeimanis]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/PatomkinGames]YouTube[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/patomkin/]Instagram[/url] and: http://patomkin.com/
